images.title: 04 · Brückenteilnetz · jetzt
images.caption: Wien · Fortsetzung und Höhenübergänge über drei Kacheln.
images.scope: Three complete source tiles frame the extended valid partial bridge/ground field. Previously planned affine surfaces are retained; two C1 height transitions with finite C0 faces. Remaining source IDs retain omission reasons in the original plan. Indoor/tunnel/other routes, terrain/water, rails, piers and structure remain uncertified.
